package.name: uwb_pozyx_bridge
package.description:
Bridges Gazebo UWB ranging to ArduPilot's external navigation source by sending MAVLink ODOMETRY (331) messages over a serial port.
Despite the package name, this is NOT a Pozyx/Beacon bridge: ArduPilot's Pozyx Beacon protocol and its layout conventions (N pattern, BCN_ORIENT_YAW) do not apply here. The anchor layout is free-form and defined by uwb_layout.py. See docs/NOTES.md.
